25264-newfoundland-and-the-jingoes-an-ap.description: A book by John Fretwell. and protecting me, and I should have a future to which I   could look forward with confidence. America would restore me to   hope and life: Great Britain allows me to sink, contenting herself   with advising me to be patient. Why should I continue loyal when   my loyalty was so contemptuously valued?"--JAMES ANTHONY FROUDE   (from "The English in the West Indies," Nov.

51365-ignaz-jan-paderewski.title: Ignaz Jan Paderewski
51365-ignaz-jan-paderewski.creator: Unknown
51365-ignaz-jan-paderewski.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. s him to find a reason for his appreciations; he may not be enthusiastic without measure, for his nature makes him see both brilliancy and flaws in the rarest gems of art; indeed, the flaws act as a foil to the brilliancies. And so it comes about that the professional critic is often at loggerheads with the verdict of the public, or appears to be so.

arxiv-2105-06110.title: Zipf’s law for cosmic structures: how large are the greatest structures in the universe?
arxiv-2105-06110.creator: Giordano De Marzo 1,2,3, Francesco Sylos Labini 1, Luciano Pietronero 1,2,4
arxiv-2105-06110.description: Abstract The statistical characterization of the distribution of visible matter in the universe is a central problem in modern cosmology. In this respect, a crucial question still lacking a definitive answer concerns how large are the greatest structures in the universe.

arxiv-2105-11741.title: ConSERT: A Contrastive Framework for Self-Supervised Sentence Representation Transfer
arxiv-2105-11741.creator: Yuanmeng Yan, Rumei Li, Sirui Wang, Fuzheng Zhang, Wei Wu, Weiran Xu
arxiv-2105-11741.description: Abstract Learning high-quality sentence representations benefits a wide range of natural language processing tasks. Though BERT-based pre-trained language models achieve high performance on many downstream tasks, the native derived sentence representations are proved to be collapsed and thus produce a poor performance on the semantic textual similarity (STS) tasks.

arxiv-2207-12213.title: On Computing Probabilistic Explanations for Decision Trees
arxiv-2207-12213.creator: Marcelo Arenas, Pablo Barceló, Miguel Romero, Bernardo SubercaseauxAuthors are listed in alphabetical orderCorrespondence at bsuberca@cs.cmu.edu
arxiv-2207-12213.description: Abstract Formal XAI (explainable AI) is a growing area that focuses on computing explanations with mathematical guarantees for the decisions made by ML models. Inside formal XAI, one of the most studied cases is that of explaining the choices taken by decision trees, as they are traditionally deemed as one of the most interpretable classes of models.

arxiv-2305-13693.title: Automated Metrics for Medical Multi-Document Summarization Disagree with Human Evaluations
arxiv-2305-13693.creator: Lucy Lu Wang, Yulia Otmakhova, Jay DeYoung, Thinh Hung Truong, Bailey E. Kuehl, Erin Bransom, Byron C. Wallace
arxiv-2305-13693.description: Abstract Evaluating multi-document summarization (MDS) quality is difficult. This is especially true in the case of MDS for biomedical literature reviews, where models must synthesize contradicting evidence reported across different documents. Prior work has shown that rather than performing the task, models may exploit shortcuts that are difficult to detect using standard n n -gram similarity metrics such as ROUGE.

arxiv-2402-14869.title: Using Harmonics for Low-Cost Jamming
arxiv-2402-14869.creator: Vasilis Ieropoulos, Eirini Anthi Cardiff University, School of Computer Science & Informatics, Cardiff, UK
arxiv-2402-14869.description: Abstract The digitalisation of the modern schooling system has led to multiple schools and organisations buying similar hardware. Electronic equipment like wireless microphones, projectors, touchscreen displays etc., have been almost standardised with a few well-known brands leading the market. This has led to the adoption of common frequency ranges between brands with many sticking between 600-670 MHz.

arxiv-2405-02829.title: An FPT Algorithm for the Exact Matching Problem and NP-hardness of Related Problems
arxiv-2405-02829.creator: Hitoshi Murakami, Yutaro Yamaguchi
arxiv-2405-02829.description: Abstract The exact matching problem is a constrained variant of the maximum matching problem: given a graph with each edge having a weight 0 0 or 1 1 and an integer k k , the goal is to find a perfect matching of weight exactly k k .

arxiv-2502-01970.title: Parking Spaces for Complex Reflection Groups
arxiv-2502-01970.creator: Jason Stack
arxiv-2502-01970.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jason Stack. We answer an open problem of [ ARR15 ] and [ Rho14 ] , extending their work to irreducible well–generated complex reflection groups W W . We define a combinatorial W W -noncrossing parking space and an algebraic W W -parking space for such W W , and exhibit a ( W × C ) (W\times C) -equivariant isomorphism between the two. As a consequence of this isomorphism, we enumerate the W W -noncrossing parking functions.

arxiv-2506-03194.title: HueManity: Probing Fine-Grained Visual Perception in MLLMs
arxiv-2506-03194.creator: Rynaa Grover, Jayant Sravan Tamarapalli, Sahiti Yerramilli, Nilay Pande
arxiv-2506-03194.description: Abstract Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at high-level visual reasoning, but their performance on nuanced perceptual tasks remains surprisingly limited. We present HueManity, a benchmark designed to assess visual perception in MLLMs. The dataset comprises 83,850 images featuring two-character alphanumeric strings embedded in Ishihara test style dot patterns, challenging models on precise pattern recognition.

arxiv-2507-07094.title: Numbers with three close factorizations and central lattice points on hyperbolas
arxiv-2507-07094.creator: Tsz Ho Chan
arxiv-2507-07094.description: Abstract In this paper, we continue the study of three close factorizations of an integer and correct a mistake of a previous result. This turns out to be related to lattice points close to the center point ( N , N ) (\sqrt{N},\sqrt{N}) of the hyperbola x ​ y = N xy=N .

arxiv-2602-16955.title: Theory of striped dynamic spectra of the Crab pulsar high-frequency interpulse
arxiv-2602-16955.creator: Mikhail V. Medvedev
arxiv-2602-16955.description: Abstract A theory of the spectral “zebra” pattern of the Crab pulsar’s high-frequency interpulse (HFIP) radio emission is developed. The observed emission bands are interference maxima caused by multiple ray propagation through the pulsar magnetosphere. The high-contrast interference pattern is the combined effect of gravitational lensing and plasma de-lensing of light rays.

asher-henry-hudson-navigator-1860.title: Henry Hudson the Navigator
asher-henry-hudson-navigator-1860.creator: George M. Asher (ed.)
asher-henry-hudson-navigator-1860.description: The Hakluyt Society edition of Hudson's journals, containing the 15 June 1608 mermaid sighting off Novaya Zemlya — the classic Arctic mermaid account, witnessed by Thomas Hilles and Robert Rayner.

europmc-pmc4624804.title: Global and Regional Estimates of Prevalent and Incident Herpes Simplex Virus Type 1 Infections in 2012.
europmc-pmc4624804.creator: Looker KJ, Magaret AS, May MT, Turner KM, Vickerman P, Gottlieb SL, Newman LM.
europmc-pmc4624804.description: Background Herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1) commonly causes orolabial ulcers, while HSV-2 commonly causes genital ulcers. However, HSV-1 is an increasing cause of genital infection. Previously, the World Health Organization estimated the global burden of HSV-2 for 2003 and fo

gao-gaoreports-gao-05-388.creator: U.S. Government Accountability Office
gao-gaoreports-gao-05-388.description: Federal Bureau of Investigation: Accountability over the HIPAA Funding of Health Care Fraud Investigations Is Inadequate (2005).

pmc-11416693.title: Factors Affecting Brain Drain and a Solution to Reduce it in Iran’s Health System: A Qualitative Study
pmc-11416693.creator: Mohadeseh Ghanbari-Jahromi, Milad Ahmadi Marzaleh
pmc-11416693.description: Background: Brain drain is an issue of concern in developing countries. Many factors are involved in this issue, and their identification can be a good guide for decision-makers at different management levels. Therefore, the present study was carried out to identify the factors affecting brain drain and solutions to reduce it in Iran’s health system.

pmc-11431481.title: Study on the Structural Features of Eight Dendrobium Polysaccharides and Their Protective Effects on Gastric Mucosa
pmc-11431481.creator: Haonan Wang, Ying Wang, Yuanxi Liu, Jinxin Xie, Yazhong Zhang, Hongyu Jin, Feng Wei, Shuangcheng Ma
pmc-11431481.description: This study aimed to analyze the structure of polysaccharides from eight different Dendrobium species and their protective effects on gastric mucosa. Ultraviolet (UV) analysis showed that the contents of eight polysaccharides ranged from 51.89 ± 6.91% to 80.57 ± 11.63%; the degree of acetylation ranged from 0.17 ± 0.03 to 0.48 ± 0.03.

pmc-11571468.title: Poor Joint Work in the Lower Limbs during a Tennis Forehand Groundstroke after a Cross-Over Step Inhibits an Increase in the Racket Speed
pmc-11571468.creator: Yuta Kawamoto, Takahito Suzuki, Yoichi Iino, Shinsuke Yoshioka, Daisuke Takeshita, Fukashiro Senshi
pmc-11571468.description: A forward run-up and stepping are used to accelerate hitting tools or throwing objects in sports. This study aimed to investigate the effect of a forward cross-over step on the speed of a hitting tool by analyzing the joint work and mechanical energy of the whole body and the hitting tool using inverse dynamics.

pmc-11629820.title: Integrated Single‐Cell and Spatial Transcriptome Reveal Metabolic Gene SLC16A3 as a Key Regulator of Immune Suppression in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-11629820.creator: Qianlong Kang, Xiaomeng Yin, Zhenru Wu, Aiping Zheng, Lusi Feng, Xuelei Ma, Li Li
pmc-11629820.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is one of the most lethal cancers, usually diagnosed at an advanced stage. Metabolic reprogramming plays a significant role in HCC progression, probably related to immune evasion, yet the key gene is unclear. In this study, six metabolism‐related genes with prognostic implications were screened.

pmc-11643785.title: Trends and Motivations in Dietary Supplement Use Among People with Diabetes: A Population-Based Analysis Using National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey Data from the 2009–2020 Period
pmc-11643785.creator: Yan Jiang, Xuhui Chen, Zhen Cai, Ying Yao, Shuaiwen Huang
pmc-11643785.description: Objectives: Dietary supplements have gained attention among people with diabetes as an alternative and complementary treatment, yet there is a limited understanding of supplement use and the motivations behind it. Methods: Data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) from the 2009–2020 period were analyzed, including data on 5784 people with diabetes aged 20 years or older.

pmc-12395742.title: Cross-neutralising antibodies to SARS-CoV-2 in sera from straw-coloured fruit bats (Eidolon helvum) in Nigeria
pmc-12395742.creator: Hooman Goharriz, Guanghui Wu, Veronica O. Ameh, Amanda H. Seekings, Joan Amaya-Cuesta, Lorraine M. McElhinney, Claude T. Sabeta
pmc-12395742.description: BackgroundStraw-coloured fruit bats (Eidolon helvum; ) are widely distributed in Africa and are known reservoirs for viruses with zoonotic potential. These bats are widely hunted in West and Central Africa for human consumption as food source and medicine. This practice increases the potential for spillover of zoonotic disease to the human population.

pmc-12635840.title: Mantle cell lymphoma presenting primarily as cutaneous lesions: A case report
pmc-12635840.creator: Pei-Yu Zhou, Wei Chen, Lin Wang
pmc-12635840.description: BACKGROUNDMantle cell lymphoma (MCL) is an aggressive B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma that rarely presents with cutaneous involvement, which typically occurs in advanced disease stages. Primary cutaneous manifestations are particularly uncommon and frequently misdiagnosed. We report a diagnostically challenging case of MCL that first appeared as a nodule on the lower leg.

pmc-13087200.title: Atractylenolide III Alleviates the Lipid Metabolic Disorders in Ovariectomy‐Induced Estrogen‐Deficient Mice Through Repairing Intestinal Inflammation and Microenvironment
pmc-13087200.creator: Xu Yanyan, Qu Yanyu, Geng Qiao, Gu Jiabo, Kong Desong, Jin Heiying
pmc-13087200.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the mechanism by which Atractylenolide III (ATIII) alleviates ovariectomy‐induced, estrogen‐deficient lipid metabolism disorders through the repair of intestinal inflammation and the barrier microenvironment.MethodsFemale C57BL/six mice (8 weeks old) were randomly assigned to three groups: a blank control group (Con, n = 10), a sham surgery group (Sham, n = 10), and an ovariectomized (OVX) group (n = 70).

pmc-13151091.title: The relationship between public health emergencies and suicidal ideation: the mediating role of fear of missing out and the moderating role of conscientiousness
pmc-13151091.creator: Zhenjing Tan, Bofeng He
pmc-13151091.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPublic health emergencies have been found to be significantly associated with mental health outcomes, yet their association with suicidal ideation remains insufficiently explored. The present study aimed to examine the cross-sectional association between public health emergencies and suicidal ideation among college students, with a particular focus on the potential mediating role of fear of missing out (FoMO) and the moderating role of conscientiousness.MethodsA cross-sectional survey was conducted among 1,012 college students from a university in Guangdong Province, China.

pmc-13410594.title: Does spacer type influence bone lysis and clinical outcomes? A comparative analysis in two-stage revision for periprosthetic knee infection
pmc-13410594.creator: Cihan Ünyılmaz, Cem Çopuroğlu, Mert Özcan, Ozan Güner
pmc-13410594.description: BackgroundPeriprosthetic joint infection (PJI) following total knee arthroplasty remains a serious complication associated with substantial morbidity and complex surgical management. Two-stage revision arthroplasty is widely accepted as the gold standard treatment, in which an antibiotic-loaded cement spacer is used during the interim period to maintain joint space and deliver local antimicrobial therapy.

pmc-13468180.title: Structural Dynamics of GLP-1 Analogues: Folding Energetics, Lipidation-Driven Assembly, and Aggregation Mechanisms
pmc-13468180.creator: Angelo Santoro, Marco Macis, Anna Maria D’Ursi, Antonio Ricci

pmc-13574164.title: Ferroptosis as a target mechanism in heart and kidney disease
pmc-13574164.creator: Simar J Singh, Baljash Cheema, Hossein Ardehali
pmc-13574164.description: Ferroptosis is a distinct form of regulated cell death driven by lipid peroxidation and redox imbalance. Since its formal recognition in 2012, ferroptosis has emerged as a central pathway linking metabolic stress and oxidative injury to both physiologic and pathologic processes.

pmc-13675269.title: Global Inequalities in Female Breast Cancer Burden by Decomposition and Age-Period-Cohort Analysis, 1990–2021
pmc-13675269.creator: Ke Li, Yiyin Zhang, Zeye Liu, Shu Wang
pmc-13675269.description: PurposeOur objective was to analyze temporal trends and geographic disparities in the burden of female breast cancer from 1990 to 2021, focusing on age, period, cohort effects, and socioeconomic inequalities.MethodsUsing data from the 2021 Global Burden of Disease (GBD) study, we quantified disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) and deaths.
